watch.summary: The streamer forfeits a Rocket League match, expresses utter confusion over why he gave up, and quietly re-queues while taking a drink.

beats.what: Admits he just randomly gave up.
Expresses utter confusion at his own lack of motivation.
Claims 'That's not me' and takes a long sip from his water bottle.
Loads into a 3v3 match to reset.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I don't understand what happened to me, bro.
watch.why: The streamer's mild existential confusion over why he forfeits mid-game is amusingly relatable. However, it lacks a strong punchline or high-energy joke to make it truly memorable.
